title: Collection export reports the collection, item position and clip for every mistake
description:
As a crate digger, I want mistakes in a collection export reported with the collection, item position and clip, so that I can fix the collection instead of guessing.

```gherkin
Feature: Collection export reports every mistake with its location
  Scenario: Collections need a library
    When I export the collection "digs" to "out" without "--library"
    Then the export fails with "collections are kept in a library; pass --library <dir>"

  Scenario: An unknown collection suggests the nearest one and lists the rest
    Given a library with the collections "digs" and "horns"
    When I export the collection "dig" to "out" from the library
    Then the export fails with "no collection named \"dig\"; did you mean \"digs\"? (collections: digs, horns)"

  Scenario: An empty collection writes nothing
    Given a library with the empty collection "later"
    When I export the collection "later" to "out" from the library
    Then the export succeeds with nothing written
    And it says "later is empty"

  Scenario: An item whose audio is missing names its position and clip, and nothing is written
    Given the collection "digs" holds, in order, "riff" and "loop-1"
    And the library's audio for the sample of "loop-1" is missing
    When I export the collection "digs" to "out" from the library
    Then the export fails with "digs item 2 (loop-1 of marine-band/Thunderer.mp3): audio file not found"
    And "out/digs" does not exist

  Scenario: An existing folder is not overwritten without --force
    Given the folder "out/digs" exists
    When I export the collection "digs" to "out" from the library
    Then the export fails with "out/digs exists; use --force to replace it"
```
